title: Key West Parasailing - Next to Cruise Port with Amazing Views
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age to fly is 6 years old
Minors under 18 must have an actual or adoptive parent present at check in with ID to sign waivers
The total weight limit is 450 lbs for Tandem and Triple Flights
All flights are 2-3 at a time. Triple Flights are weather and weight permitting
Pregnant guests may not participate in parasailing
Children age 6-14 must have an adult present on the boat. Children 6-13 must fly with guest 14+. Guests 6-13 must be supervised at all times.
Minors 15-17 may go out on tour without an adult, parent must still be present at check in with ID to sign waivers.
All guests must sign liability waiver prior to boarding the vessel.
policies: All guests 18 years + must bring government issued picture ID
Check in is 30 minutes prior to departure time

Alcohol cannot be consumed prior to participating in any activity. Guests arriving to check in with alcohol in their possession or under the influence will be restricted from entering the water, turned away or required to reschedule. Tickets are non-refundable.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Fury’s Key West Parasailing offers an exhilarating way to experience the stunning beauty of Key West from the sky. This unique adventure combines breathtaking views with the thrill of flight, making it a must-do for both beginners and seasoned adventurers.

As you take off, you'll feel the rush of soaring above the azure waters, enjoying bird’s-eye views of the island that are truly unmatched. You can fly tandem or triple, depending on the Captain's discretion, ensuring a safe and fun experience for everyone.

One of the standout features is the optional ocean dip, where you can cool off in the refreshing waters before heading back up into the sky. Keep an eye out for dolphins swimming below or colorful tropical birds alongside you for added excitement.

To capture these unforgettable moments, digital photos are available for purchase at the end of your trip. Get ready for a sky-high adventure that combines thrill, beauty, and lasting memories!
